A Note From Leadership
“The successful integration of Stambaugh Ness and Zweig Group is a testament to the incredible dedication, collaboration, and hard work of our teams. What makes this accomplishment especially impressive is the sheer number of moving parts our people managed simultaneously, from navigating the merger and welcoming Aphias as our private equity partner to aligning systems, processes, and people, all while keeping our businesses running and serving our clients. This was no small undertaking, and our teams rose to the challenge with professionalism, flexibility, and a shared commitment to getting it right. I couldn't be prouder of what we've accomplished together, and I'm excited about the foundation we've built for SNZweig's future.”

Feature Spotlights
Merger Update · October 2026

SNZweig merger update: Building our future together

It's an exciting time for our organization as Stambaugh Ness and Zweig Group continue coming together as SNZweig. What began as a strategic partnership has evolved into an opportunity to combine our strengths, expand our capabilities and build something even greater together.

With the support of our new private equity partner, Aphias Capital, we're laying the groundwork for continued growth, innovation and new opportunities for our people and the clients we serve.

A major milestone in our journey

The September announcement of our merger marked a significant milestone for both organizations. By bringing together our expertise, relationships and industry knowledge, we're creating a stronger, more comprehensive organization dedicated to serving the architecture, engineering and construction (AEC) industry.

Our goal is to preserve the strengths that have made each organization successful while creating new opportunities to learn from one another, collaborate across teams and grow together.

A tremendous team effort

Over the past several months, teams across both organizations have worked diligently to coordinate the many moving pieces involved in bringing our businesses together, from preparing for our partnership with Aphias Capital to aligning technology, systems, processes, communications and operations. What's especially impressive is that this work happened while everyone kept managing their regular responsibilities and delivering for our clients.

To everyone who has contributed time, expertise and energy: thank you. Your efforts are making a meaningful difference, and they have not gone unnoticed.

What's ahead for SNZweig?

As we move through the next phases of our integration, we'll keep strengthening connections across our teams, aligning our operations and creating a consistent employee and client experience. You can expect continued updates as we make progress, introduce new resources and find ways to work more effectively together.

Not every process or system will come together overnight. Our commitment is to keep you informed, support you through the transition and create opportunities for collaboration along the way.

Moving forward, together

There's still work ahead, but we've already shown what we can accomplish when we come together with a shared purpose. Thank you for your continued dedication, patience, flexibility and commitment to making SNZweig a success. We're excited about what comes next, and even more excited to build it with you.

Feature SpotlightTeam Spotlight
Celebrating Our People
Internal IT Team

The team behind a seamless transition

The internal IT team played a critical role in bringing two organizations together under the new SNZweig brand. Through their dedication, expertise and willingness to go above and beyond, the team successfully transitioned employees, systems, data and technology services while maintaining business continuity and minimizing disruption.

The following highlights summarize the team's key accomplishments throughout the integration.

Rob GillDirector of IT
Drew LessardSenior IT Systems Administrator
Joe DiceSenior Technical Support Specialist
Caleb TamuraTechnical Support Specialist
01

The migration

Planned and executed the migration of Zweig Group's Microsoft 365 environment into the Stambaugh Ness tenant, moving email, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint and related services at scale.

02

Day one ready

Provisioned accounts, validated access, and ran onboarding and training sessions so incoming Zweig employees could use their systems and tools on day one.

03

The rebrand

Executed the domain transition to SNZweig across email, authentication, DNS, security and applications, working through third-party integrations, SSO changes and vendor coordination.

04

Hands-on support

Provided hands-on support before, during and after migration weekend, and kept answering elevated ticket volumes and user questions well after launch.

Their work laid the technology foundation for the firm's future growth and positioned SNZweig to operate as one integrated organization from day one.

Firm UpdateFrom HR

Performance review season is here

Preparing for growth conversations: 2026 performance reviews launch

The 2026 performance review cycle officially launched Oct. 5 and includes all employees in a single, unified review process. This year's cycle is designed to create a comprehensive record of employee accomplishments, growth, strengths, development opportunities and feedback to support coaching, calibration, compensation discussions and future development planning.

There were multiple firmwide and manager-specific training sessions preparing employees and leaders for the 2026 review cycle. Employees are learning the new process, while managers are being trained on calibration, coaching conversations, compensation governance and development planning.

Message to employees

Performance reviews are intended to support coaching, development, recognition and career growth, with all employees participating in a unified review process this year.

Watch the Firmwide Recording

Key dates

  1. Oct. 5Review cycle opened and review activities became available.
  2. Oct. 23Due date for self-reviews, peer reviews and upward feedback.
  3. Nov. 13Manager downward reviews due.

What employees can expect

This year's process includes:

  • Self-assessments
  • Peer feedback
  • Upward and manager feedback
  • Calibration discussions to ensure consistency across teams
  • Career development and growth conversations
  • Review discussions conducted through Rippling's performance management tools

Focus on growth and development

Recent firmwide and manager training sessions reinforced that performance reviews are more than an administrative process. They are designed to:

  • Recognize accomplishments and impact
  • Support coaching and development planning
  • Identify strengths and growth opportunities
  • Inform future career discussions
  • Provide consistent expectations across the organization

Resources available

Employees and managers will have access to:

  • Training recordings
  • Rippling reference guides
  • Performance-cycle documentation
  • Quick-reference materials and Loom tutorials to support completion of the process

Firm UpdateFrom Marketing
Event Recap
M&A Next Symposium · Park City

M&A Next, together in Park City

Following a milestone year for the AEC industry’s premier symposium on mergers and acquisitions, M&A Next returned Sept. 28-29, 2026, with an even sharper focus on what’s ahead. Designed for firm leaders, buyers, sellers and advisors navigating an evolving deal landscape, M&A Next 2026 delivered candid insights, real-world perspective, and high-value connections that shape smarter decisions. From valuation and capital strategy to ownership transition and long-term growth, it was where the industry came to look forward.

The symposium took place at the Grand Hyatt Deer Valley in Park City, Utah, and the opening session was a panel on the SNZweig merger itself.

View the Full Photo Gallery
Event Recap
ElevateAEC 2026 · Park City

ElevateAEC 2026, celebrated together

The ElevateAEC Conference and Awards Gala brought the AEC community together in Park City, Utah, Sept. 29 to Oct. 1, 2026, and celebrated the winners of the AEC Financial Leadership Awards, known as the Finnies.

Built around the theme Uncharted, the conference at the Grand Hyatt Deer Valley focused on leading without a playbook. Keynote speakers Kevin Vallely, KP Reddy and Andra Kidd spoke on courage, people in an AI future, and growth and resilience, while panels explored how to lead with clarity, speed and action and how AI moves from idea to impact. Attendees chose from breakout sessions across three tracks (Talent and Leadership, Growth and Strategy and Performance and Technology), connected at the welcome reception, the sponsor expo hall and Connections on Main, and wrapped up the week at the Black Tie Awards Dinner and Gala with a look ahead to 2027.

SNZweig Firm-Wide Training Series: Q4 2026

As we close out 2026 and prepare for 2027, our Firm-Wide Training Series continues with three impactful sessions focused on growth, operational excellence and industry insight. Oct. 27noon ET

Participants will learn practical ways to apply their CliftonStrengths to daily work and gain insight into how strengths-based leadership will support the way we work together in 2027.

Why attend?

  • Strengthen collaboration across teams
  • Learn how strengths will be incorporated into our culture and development efforts moving forward
